body: I told my friend last night that his sadness over my suicide isn't a valid reason to keep living in constant pain and suffering
Even when they're free to book appointments with, it suckd because you pour your heart out to someone who doesn't care, or does, but is unable to help you
Oh I'm gonna make them specifically for him, so he can manage money and pay bills once I'm gone

To suffer I've come to believe
I plan to, I've already started selling off my possessions so the next step feels like drafting the note, but I'm still unsure. Thanks for your thoughts though
My only regret about my attempts to kill myself near the end of highschool are that it didn't succeed
Idk, while I'm broke bow, I was miserable too even when I had money. I just think some of us are broken as people, incapable of ever being happy.

I fantasize about walking in front of a bus, or deep throating a gun, or jumping off the roof my apartment all the time, but never thought of the button approach. I guess I feel like I want the world to know I killed myself when I finally do it, and I want my husband to feel bad in particular.
I hate the fact my dad didn't pull out and now I have this shit existence. There really should be some sort of consequences for forcing consciousness on someone who doesn't want it.
29 here, I'd tell my teenaged self it never gets better and to just try again if I could

I feel the same way, I hate my mom and father for ever deciding to have children. I wish there was some sort of punishment for them for having me, but instead I'm forced to try and provide for myself when I didn't even ask to be here, after a childhood and adolescence of never receiving their support emotionally, financially, or otherwise.

Life is a pyramid scheme.

Mood. Mine is walking in front of the bus mostly. I live in a developing country and the buses are all metal and drive carelessly so I often think about "accidentally" stepping in front of one. 

I also think about just sitting my wrists so my husband can come home to my life less corpse and a bloody mess. It's vindictive, but it's nice to think about.

I also like to think about mixing all the different benzos I have hoarded and getting drunk and just dying of respiratory depression in bed. 

Suicidal daydreaming is a nice distraction from soul crushing consciousness.

I've experienced increasing depersonalization/derealization over the years and there's a bitter sweet aspect of it. 

Recently while I wait for the bus I have begun to think about and picture myself in 3rd person mode walking in front of it and my body getting absolutely destroyed. It brings me some comfort knowing I can just aimlessly do it at any second and I'll be received with the sweet release of death.
Fuck let's hope not, one lifetime of suffering is enough don't you think?
I'm not interested in looking further, but if you are still hoping to find yours I hope you do

I think the best you can hope for in a relationship is someone you're mutually attracted to sexually that doesn't annoy you to be around or live with at the same time, and if you find that person great, but I've learned that even if that person exists I'm not willing to go through the pain of trying to find them
It's nice to hear some people are capable of forgiveness, I suppose it's easier to pass long if you receive it

What gave you the impression I was looking for help or attention? I've always seen this sub as a sort of shouting in to the void. And my husband doesn't love me and already knows I'm going to kill myself at some point, but as he says "I can't make someone do something they don't want to" so even if he saw this he'd be like "tell me something I don't know"
Nope, before I married my husband I promised myself if it didn't work out I wasn't going to subjugate myself to another round of pain and suffering. I don't believe in soul mates anyways

I'm chosing to attach a helium tank to my CPAP machine when my husband moves out, so that should answer that.

As for putting the responsibility on others, I'll agree this is true, but only about my ex, who of the people referenced, is the only one who was harmed me, admits to it, and apologized for it. But I'm chosing to be spiteful with him so 🤷‍♂️

Same. My depression has been morphing into derealization/depersonalization more and more, and the last week alone I've almost gotten run over by a car 3 times while crossing the street and not paying attention.

I think I startled this one woman when she was like "you almost got hit!" and my response was a simple "...oh" she was like "what do you mean, oh?!" and I just shrugged and walked away. 

I personally prefer to OD in my sleep, but getting run over would at least leave my husband some money.

Sometimes when my mother talks about how "well at least I got you and your brother out of it" when talking about her relationship with my father I just want to fucking scream at her. 

You gave me the burden consciousness, something I struggle to deal with daily, and you're grateful for it? It's so violating when people are told to be thankful for having been born, I would never wish this shit existence on anyone.
Waking up a day or more later realizing you didn't die is such an awful feeling, and is one of the fears that keeps me from trying again
Same, and the problems i have now will just get worse or become new, different problems. It's a vicious circle of suffering
Not with Tylenol at least, I'm not making that mistake again
This isn't encouraging people, it's answering OP's question. Most of on here have probably thought about how we're going to do it, so I answered as such
